description: Source code for a wizard interface in OpenERP/Odoo for modifying report templates (.SXW files) using Tiny OpenOffice plugin. Includes form definitions, report content handling, and wizard states.

classes.name: base_report_designer_modify
classes.description: Wizard class for report modification, handling report upload, retrieval, and user interaction states.

methods.name: _upload_report_clear
methods.description: Clears the uploaded report file data.

methods.name: _upload_report
methods.description: Processes and saves the uploaded report, converting SXW to RML.

methods.name: _get_report
methods.description: Retrieves the current report's SXW content encoded in base64.
